team.title: Team seats
team.subtitle: Invite teammates to your account. Seat count depends on your plan.
team.inviteFull: All your seats are in use. Buy a plan with more seats, or remove a teammate to free one.
team.inviteCreated: We've emailed an invite to {{email}}. You can also share this link:
team.statusSuspendedHint: This seat is paused because the plan has fewer seats than the team. The account owner can free a seat or buy a plan with more seats.
team.suspendedBannerBody: Your company's plan has fewer seats than it has teammates, so this seat is paused. You can still view everything, but posting jobs and unlocking candidates are blocked until the owner upgrades the plan or frees a seat.
team.memberViewNote: Only the account owner can invite or remove teammates.

invite.title: You have been invited to join a team
invite.titleWithCompany: {{company}} has invited you to their team
invite.body: Join as a teammate to post jobs, message candidates and work from the same company account.
invite.registerInstead: I don't have an account yet
invite.mustUseInvitedEmail: Use {{email}} — this invite only works for that address.
invite.switchAccount: Sign in with a different account
invite.wrongAccount: You're signed in as {{signedInAs}}, but this invite was sent to {{invitedEmail}}. Sign in with that account to accept it.
invite.seekerAccount: You're signed in with a job seeker account. Team seats are for employer accounts only — sign in with an employer account to accept this invite.
invite.successBody: Your account is now part of {{company}}. You share the same jobs, credits and unlocked candidates.

errors.invalid: This invite link is invalid, has already been used, or has expired. Ask the person who invited you to send a new one.
errors.rejected: This invite can't be accepted with this account. Ask the person who invited you to send a new invite to the right email address.
errors.badRequest: This invite can't be used with this account. It may have expired, already been used, or been sent to a different kind of account. Ask the person who invited you to send a new one.
errors.emailMismatch: This invite was sent to a different email address. Sign in with the invited account to accept it.
errors.noSeat: This team has no free seats left. Ask the account owner to upgrade their plan or free up a seat, then try again.
errors.workspaceConflict: This account already runs its own company workspace with jobs, credits or payments, so it cannot also hold a seat on another team. Accept the invite with a different account.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong and we couldn't accept this invite. Please try again.
errors.notOwner: Only the account owner can change the team. Ask them to make this change.
